artworks.title: A la Conference de la Paix
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted in a sketch style. The first person is standing, with hands resting on their knees. They have short, dark hair, a head covering, and wear a dark robe. The second person is seated on a bench, wearing a light-colored cloak and a helmet. The background is minimalistic, with a blank wall and a partial door outline. Beside the seated person is a table with various items.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in blue and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious gathering. The image shows a congregation of figures looking upwards towards a central chalice and a shining circle. Luminous rays radiate outward from the chalice. To the right of the chalice, a faint image of a cloaked figure stands. Surrounding the scene, text indicates the event is the "25ème Congrès Eucharistique International" held in Lourdes in 1914 from July 22nd to 26th. The style is reminiscent of early 20th-century poster art with graphic lines and a limited color palette focusing on black and blue hues.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in blue and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a semicircular shape in the top half filled with radiating lines converging towards a central point with a suspended chalice. Below, there are vaguely defined, cloaked figures seated or kneeling, resembling a congregation. Among them, the curved lines of shepherd-like staffs are visible. A ghostly figure in the upper right section bears a likeness to a religious apparition.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in green and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering beneath a dome. The image shows a crowd of hooded and robed figures holding shepherd's crooks and facing a glowing chalice in the sky, with a bright light shining above it. The chalice is the central focus, with lines of light extending from it. A robed figure is faintly visible within the dome surrounding the crowd. The drawing conveys a sense of reverence and communal focus on the mysterious event.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering focused on a luminous chalice under a dome. The scene depicts a large assembly of cloaked figures, whose heads are mostly bowed. At the center of their focus is a bright chalice suspended above the crowd, with beams of light emanating from it. To one side of the dome above, a figure in ethereal robes appears to be hovering. The use of shading and lines indicates a soft illumination, creating a serene atmosphere. The markings around the dome suggest architectural structures or spiritual rays, reinforcing the central theme of veneration.

artworks.title: First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in red and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a woman in a dynamic pose holding a mirror and an artist's brush. She is nude, with loose, wavy hair flowing back from her face. The background is a plain, light beige. The paper edges are visible.

artworks.title: First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person striking a dynamic pose while performing a high kick. They are positioned with one leg extended forward and the other slightly bent, their body leaning back slightly. The person has medium-length brown hair styled in a loose, windswept manner. They are dressed in a short, flowing dress or slip and wearing high-heeled shoes. In one hand, they are holding a closed umbrella. The background is a plain, light beige color, and above the person, there is a top hat, monocle, and chain.

artworks.title: First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched figure of a person dancing in a dynamic pose with one leg kicked high into the air. The figure is balanced on their left leg while holding an umbrella in their left hand. The person appears to have long hair flowing backward. They are wearing a dress and high-heeled shoes, emphasizing movement. A top hat and monocle are illustrated in the background.

artworks.title: "1er Salon des Humoristes, Palais des Modes (First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style)
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman in motion with a top hat in the air. The artwork is a poster for the "1er Salon de la Société des Dessinateurs Humoristes." The poster features a drawing of a woman in mid-kick, partially dressed, with an arm extending behind her holding an umbrella. The top hat appears to be flying off. The text is in French, indicating the event's date and location. The use of simple lines and a limited color palette focuses the attention on the written information and the action depicted.

artworks.title: Servir (To Serve)
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures observing a scene of commotion with aircraft overhead. The central figures are shown in military attire, with a crowd of people in the background running in distress or urgency. Above, three airplanes fly low in the sky. The artwork uses a limited color palette, primarily dark lines and shading.

artworks.title: Servir (To Serve)
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and brown on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two soldiers with arms around each other's shoulders as they walk towards a distant crowd and planes overhead. The soldiers are wearing military uniforms and boots. The background shows a group of people in motion, with planes flying in formation. The drawing is monochromatic in shades of brown. The title "SERVIR" and additional text suggest it might be a poster for a theatrical production by Henri Lavedan featuring Lucien Guitry. The drawing style is dynamic and expressive, conveying camaraderie and urgency.

artworks.title: Le Bon Feu (The Good Fire)
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and brown on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a charitable campaign poster. The image features text and a drawing of two figures inside a room. The text, "Le Bon Feu," references a charitable initiative from 1914-1916, and is complemented by a handwritten letter from Jean Wolff. The drawing shows a seated figure and a standing figure covered in clothing, in front of a simple room interior with basic fixtures like a mantle and bottle. The poster's text implores readers not to forget those who are cold, emphasizing providing warmth through coal distribution to those in need. The imagery is rendered in a monochromatic color scheme with soft, textured lines, indicative of graphite or charcoal drawings for illustrative purposes.

artworks.title: Nymph Supported by Two Satyrs (Nymphe s'asseyant sur les mains de deux satyres)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a child surrounded by two faun-like creatures. In the center, a nude child is held upright by two satyr-like figures. The background is filled with foliage and rocks. The composition includes detailed line work and hatching.

artworks.title: The Satyrs' Dance (Danse de satyres)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures in a forested scene. It depicts various mythical elements and creatures within a lush forest setting. The scene includes figures in a combination of human and animal characteristics, a smaller dynamic creature, and detailed vegetation. The style of the drawing resembles classical or baroque etching.

artworks.title: Nymph Astride a Satyr (Jeune fille a califourchon sur un satyre)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a scene in a natural setting. The central focus is a circular area encasing a centaur and humanoid figures. The figures appear to be interacting closely, with a dynamic composition suggesting movement or struggle. Surrounding this central scene are dense areas of foliage and trees depicted with intricate linework that blends harmoniously with the main figures. The foreground includes a broken piece of pottery. The drawing is richly detailed, showcasing skilled use of shading and texture to convey both the figures and the landscape's form and depth.

artworks.title: The Satyr's Family (La famille du satyre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures interacting. The scene includes a satyr and other figures, possibly another satyr and cherubic figures, surrounded by lush foliage. The drawing is encased in a rectangular frame with detailed line work and rich texture.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and the Infant Saint John the Baptist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.6 x 25.3 cm (8 7/8 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with multiple figures. On the right, there is a seated woman holding a swaddled infant. Beside her stands a man holding a staff. In the center left, a naked child stands on a decorated plinth with a pole. Seated beside the child, a woman winds something onto a spindle. In the top left corner, two women are engaged in a conversation. The background features a tiled floor and detailed walls, suggesting an interior setting with steps.

artworks.title: Lucretia
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26 x 17.5 cm (10 1/4 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure with long hair cascading over their shoulders. The person has softly defined facial features, prominent cheekbones, and a relaxed expression. They are wearing a draped garment that reveals much of their body and are holding onto the drapery with one hand. The background features architectural elements like a large archway with ornate decorations and a tiled floor.

artworks.title: Bacchus and His Attendants
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring four figures surrounded by nature elements. The composition shows four nude or partially draped figures amidst lush vegetation and rock formations. The central figure holds a cluster of small branches or a vine, while another to the left carries a staff and is partially draped in flowing cloth. A figure on the right leans against a tree trunk, holding a long stick. The scene includes detailed textures such as skin, drapery folds, and foliage.

artworks.title: La promenade du soir
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines and delicate hatching on off-white paper, a young, clean-shaven man and a young woman stand in a garden as another woman faces away in this vertical etching and engraving. The people whose faces we see have delicate features with large eyes and smiling lips. To our left, the man’s hair is brushed back from his high forehead and curled around his ears. The long hair is tied with an oversized bow or perhaps enclosed within a pouch at the back of his neck, or both. He wears a frilly cravat under a waistcoat and a knee-length coat. His breeches are buckled at the knee over stockings and buckled shoes. A sword hangs from his far hip, and he holds a hat with that hand. He holds up a tiny bouquet of flowers with his other hand as he leans toward the woman. She faces him with her hands clasped down in front of her. Her hair is pulled up and back. She wears a choker tied at the back of her neck and a gown with a tight bodice and flaring, full skirt. Layers of ruffles, presumably lace, cascade down from the elbow-length sleeves of the dress. She stands ramrod straight, but one tiny foot in a heeled shoe is slightly extended toward the man, mirroring his stance. The second woman is just behind her far shoulder. That woman holds a partially open fan and looks up and off into the distance. A thin dog standing behind the man’s feet faces away from us and looks toward the second woman. The garden is planted with flowers behind a trellised pen and trees in a formal row to our right, and a bench nestled into rosebushes to the left. A bust of a woman on a tall, square column rises up against a tree beyond the bench, and a house and gateway are on the far side of the formal garden. The print is engraved to look like a frame encloses the image. The delicate outer edge of the frame alternates inward-facing U shapes with short lines. Under the image is a plaque with fluttering ribbons at the top and garlands of leaves below. The leaves meet where a long torch overlaps a bow with its bowstring undone at the bottom center. On the plaque text reads, “LA PROMENADE DU SOIR. Jenues Beautés qui suyez l’esclavage, Vous pouves écouter des propos séducteurs: Mais d’un Bouquet n’acceptez point l’hommage, Souvent l’Amour s’est cache dans les fleurs.” Text under the printed frame reads “I.H.E. inv. S. Freudeberg del.” to the left, “A Paris chez Buldet rue de Gesvres” at the center, and “Ingouf junior Sculp. 1774.” to the right.

artworks.title: L'evenement au bal
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos and Francois-Robert Ingouf after Sigmund Freudenberger
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man in an elaborate, interior scene. The woman is standing, leaning forward, with an ornate hairstyle. She is wearing an intricate gown with floral patterns. The man is kneeling before her, holding her hands, dressed in a detailed robe. Other figures and opulent architectural details surround them. A chandelier is on the wall, and a table is topped with candles. The setting suggests luxury and grandeur.

artworks.title: L'occupation
artworks.artist: Charles Louis Lingée after Sigmund Freudenberger
artworks.description: The image shows two women and one man in an elaborately furnished interior setting. The woman on the left is leaning slightly toward the man beside her. They are both dressed in elegant 18th-century attire and the man is holding a piece of paper. Another woman is standing on the left arranging flowers. The room is ornately decorated with framed paintings, draped curtains, and intricate furniture and wall details.

artworks.title: La toilette
artworks.artist: Nicolas Joseph Voyez after Sigmund Freudenberger
artworks.description: Three individuals are in an opulent interior setting. One woman is seated, adorned in intricate clothing and being attended to by another woman who is adjusting her hair. A man is seated nearby, dressed in formal attire and observing. The room is richly decorated with large draped curtains, a framed window, and a lavishly adorned wall. A small dog is on the floor beside the seated woman.
